name: dmitryisaenko/larafoundry
description: LaraFoundry — reusable SaaS/CRM core for Laravel (auth, multi-tenancy, RBAC, admin, helpdesk, i18n).

suggest.ext-gd: Required only to process image uploads (avatars, logos) with the default GD image driver; the initials placeholder avatar needs no extension.
suggest.ext-imagick: Alternative image driver — set larafoundry-media.image_driver to 'imagick' to use it instead of GD.
suggest.socialiteproviders/apple: Optional OAuth provider: add 'apple' to larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers after installing and registering its Socialite driver in the host.
suggest.socialiteproviders/microsoft: Optional OAuth provider: add 'microsoft' to larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers after installing and registering its Socialite driver in the host.
suggest.socialiteproviders/linkedin: Optional OAuth provider: add 'linkedin' to larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers after installing and registering its Socialite driver in the host.
suggest.socialiteproviders/twitter: Optional OAuth 2.0 Twitter/X provider (the built-in Socialite 'twitter' driver is OAuth 1.0a); install and register it, then list 'twitter' in larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers.
